name: Mixed R/W
description: 80% reads / 20% writes with JOINs across accounts and orders tables

setup_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bench_accounts (id INT8 PRIMARY KEY, name STRING NOT NULL, balance DECIMAL(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now())

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bench_orders (id INT8 PRIMARY KEY, account_id INT8 NOT NULL REFERENCES bench_accounts(id), amount DECIMAL(15,2) NOT NULL, status STRING NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now())
seed_sql: UPSERT INTO bench_accounts (id, name, balance) VALUES ($1, $2, 10000.0)

operations.name: read_join
sql: SELECT a.name, a.balance, o.amount, o.status FROM bench_accounts a LEFT JOIN bench_orders o ON o.account_id = a.id WHERE a.id = $1 LIMIT 20

operations.name: write_order
sql: INSERT INTO bench_orders (id, account_id, amount, status) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 'pending')
UPDATE bench_accounts SET balance = balance - $1 WHERE id = $2
